Dear Sir/ Madam,
Subject: Addendum to SEBI Circular on Development of Passive Funds
1. This has reference to SEBI circular No. SEBI/HO/IMD/DOF2/P/CIR/2022/69 dated
May 23, 2022 on “Development of passive funds”. The provisions of the said
circular are applicable with effect from July 01, 2022.
2. Clause 2(IV)(A) of the aforesaid circular prescribed that in respect of units of ETFs,
direct transaction with AMCs shall be facilitated for investors only for transactions
above a specified threshold of INR 25 Cr.
3. Subsequently, feedback was received from stakeholders expressing certain
challenges with respect to implementation of the above clause. Considering the

4. This circular is issued in exercise of the powers conferred under Section 11 (1) of
the Securities and Exchange Board of India Act 1992, read with the provision of
Regulation 77 of SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulation, 1996 to protect the interests of
investors in securities and to promote the development of, and to regulate the
